description.short_caption: Blood smear showing spirochetes and red blood cells.
description.detailed_description: This is a high-magnification image of a blood smear stained with a technique that highlights spirochetes. Numerous red blood cells are visible, with a few showing central pallor. Thin, spiral-shaped organisms consistent with spirochetes are seen interspersed among the red blood cells. The background is clear, and the staining technique enhances the visibility of the spirochetes.
visible_findings: red blood cells with central pallor
clear background with no other cellular elements

description.short_caption: Gram stain of blood showing Gram-positive cocci in chains.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a Gram stain of a blood sample. Numerous Gram-positive cocci are visible, arranged in chains. The background consists of red blood cells, which appear unstained. The cocci are stained purple, consistent with Gram-positive organisms, and their chain arrangement is characteristic of certain bacterial species, such as Streptococcus. The image is de-identified and is likely part of an infectious-diseases case study.
visible_findings: unstained red blood cells in the background
